infoDescription: The academic structure follows the Cameroonian bilingual education system. Modules must be configured in hierarchical order: Cycle Types → Cycles → Levels → Streams.
infoDescription2: National exams are automatically associated with exam levels (CM2→CEP, 3ème→BEPC, 1ère→Probatoire, Terminale→BAC, Form 5→GCE OL, Upper 6th→GCE AL).
